description: This file defines the OfficeReadPlatformService interface for the office module of the Fineract project. It declares methods related to retrieving office data, such as getting all offices, retrieving a specific office, and fetching office transactions.

classes.name: OfficeReadPlatformService
classes.description: Service interface for reading office-related data in the Fineract system.

methods.name: retrieveAllOffices
methods.description: Retrieves all offices, with optional inclusion of all offices based on search parameters.

methods.name: retrieveAllOfficesForDropdown
methods.description: Retrieves a list of offices suitable for dropdown selections.

methods.name: retrieveOffice
methods.description: Retrieves details for a specific office by its ID.

methods.name: retrieveOfficeWithExternalId
methods.description: Retrieves an office based on its external identifier.

methods.name: retrieveNewOfficeTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for creating a new office.

methods.name: retrieveAllowedParents
methods.description: Retrieves a collection of potential parent offices for a given office ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllOfficeTransactions
methods.description: Retrieves all transactions related to offices.

methods.name: retrieveNewOfficeTransactionDetails
methods.description: Gets details for a new office transaction.
